europe_now.title: Microsoft Outlook Global Disruption Enters Second Day
europe_now.summary: A major technical disruption affecting Microsoft services across numerous countries entered its second day. The company reported no indication of malicious activity behind the widespread outage.

sources.headline: 'One of the biggest outages ever': Disruption to Microsoft services enters second day
Major Microsoft Outlook outage disrupts services in 74 countries

europe_now.title: Czechia Prepares for Protests Over Public Media Cuts
europe_now.summary: Public demonstrations are being organized in Czechia in response to planned legislative funding reductions for public media institutions. Protesters and critics have raised concerns regarding media freedom and state interference.

sources.headline: Czechia braces for massive protest against cuts to public media

top_stories.title: Ukraine Peace Talks and European Diplomatic Involvement
top_stories.summary: Officials from the United States and Ukraine stated that European nations will participate in upcoming peace negotiations. Meanwhile, regional diplomatic efforts continue as leadership addresses ongoing security infrastructure challenges.

sources.headline: US, Ukraine say Europe to join peace talks as Putin sticks to hardline stance
'Big development' in peace talks as Ukraine says Europe to join Russia negotiations

top_stories.title: European Defense Integration Sentiment
top_stories.summary: Recent survey findings indicate strong public support among European citizens for the creation of an official EU army. Discussions surrounding regional security architecture and defense cooperation remain a central focus for member states.
